Trump: The Art of the Comeback is a 1997 book credited to businessman Donald Trump and journalist Kate Bohner . [ 1 ]
In November 1997, it was reported that Bohner was in fact the book's ghostwriter . [ 2 ]

Synopsis

[ edit ]
In the book, Donald Trump writes about his bankruptcy in 1990 and how he managed to "comeback" through negotiations.

...

Trump said he was asked by Random House to write The Art of the Comeback , his third book, after the company was impressed by his emergence from bankruptcy. [ 4 ] According to Trump's niece, Mary L.

...

On August 1, 1997, eight hours before the deadline, the final draft of the book was turned in. [ 2 ] Kate Bohner 's life as Trump's ghostwriter was documented by her friend, Candace Bushnell of The New York Observer . [ 2 ] While writing for Trump, Bohner was nicknamed "Kateso". [ 2 ] Bushnell's documentation of Bohner's ghostwriting of the book would be published in the November 3, 1997 edition of the Observer . [ 2 ]

Kate Bohner (born April 14, 1967) is an American journalist and author. She was a correspondent for CNBC , associate editor for Forbes magazine, and ghostwriter of Trump: The Art of the Comeback with Donald Trump . Bohner has also been a vlogger , investment banker, and businessperson.

Early life and education

[ edit ]
Bohner was born April 14, 1967, in Wilmington, Delaware . After studying business and international studies at the University of Pennsylvania , graduating in 1988, Bohner began her career at investment bank Lazard .

She has also written for publications such as Harper’s Bazaar , Marie Claire , and George . She reportedly co-authored Donald Trump 's 1997 book Trump: The Art of the Comeback . [ 3 ] The book hit both the New York Times (#3), the Wall Street Journal (#1) and Businessweek (#2) Bestseller's Lists. [ 4 ] However, in an article for the New York Observer which was documented on August 1, 1997 and was published in the newspaper on November 3, 1997, Candace Bushnell detailed how Bohner was in fact Trump: the Art of the Comeback' s ghostwriter.
